activeIssue.rootCause: Two diagnostic ownership defects are isolated. First, browser feature owners still rely on generic inference rather than explicitly declaring navigation/provider/onboarding/automatic/scan-projection semantics. Second, runtimeWorkflowTrace permits routeTemplate as a field but validates it with SAFE_LABEL, whose first character must be alphanumeric; every canonical API route template begins with '/', so privacy-safe API trace events are rejected with HTTP 400. Broadening SAFE_LABEL would weaken unrelated metadata validation, so route templates require a dedicated exact allowlist.
activeIssue.nextAction: Apply owner-declared semantic instrumentation plus an exact canonical route-template validator, correct /api/accounts/workspace browser templating, physically rerun trace-enabled Chromium with zero trace-event 400s, then run an exact-head full Engineering Gate.
